description: This is a shell script used for checking the authentication status of Claude Code and OpenClaw. It verifies credentials by reading local configuration files, querying JSON status from commands, and providing output in various formats (full, JSON, simple) for monitoring or automation purposes.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches the status JSON from the openclaw models command.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates status ('MISSING', 'EXPIRED', 'EXPIRING', 'OK') based on expiration timestamp.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration timestamp for Claude via the CLI status JSON.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum expiration timestamp for any openclaw anthropic profile.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Selects the profile ID with the latest expiration timestamp for anthropic profiles.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of API keys associated with the 'anthropic' provider in openclaw.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks Claude Code authentication status, either via JSON output or local credential file.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the OpenClaw (anthropic) authentication status, either via JSON or local credential files.
